metadata.provenanceNote: Rolling seven-day publication assembled from approved official cinema sources.

films.descriptionZh: 從石器時代到木星之旅，一段關於人性與進化的宏大科幻沉思。

films.canonicalTitle: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
films.displayTitle: 2026 Sundance Festival Short Film Tour (Open Captioning)
films.descriptionZh: 本单元从本年电影节遴选六部短片，包括若干评审奖得主，呈现多样国际短片样貌。
films.descriptionEn: A curated selection of six standout short films from the festival program, including Jury Award winners, offering a cross‑section of nonfiction and narrative work from around the world compiled into a single tour program.

films.descriptionZh: 三位女职员联手对抗自负的男上司，把办公室变成理想化的职场范例。
films.descriptionEn: Three working women, bound by shared resentment toward their sexist boss, seize an unexpected chance for revenge and transform their male-dominated office into a model workplace, turning fantasy into satirical reality.

films.canonicalTitle: A Better Tomorrow III: Love and Death in Saigon
films.displayTitle: A Better Tomorrow III: Love and Death in Saigon
films.descriptionZh: 年輕時的主角在戰亂的越南從事走私武器，三部曲在末段走向末日式高潮。
杨氏青春记忆中六〇年代台湾的黑帮、政治压抑与美国流行文化的交织图景。
Kubrick 的反乌托邦经典，35mm 放映并由 Rafer Guzmán 引介。
法國詩人拉伯朵的不凡人生，以詩的震撼與俏皮展開。
films.descriptionEn: The improbable life of French poet Arthur Rimbaud is unfolded with the shock and playfulness reflective of his own poetry, offering a spirited evocation of his unconventional biography.

films.descriptionZh: 被克隆回归的里普利在太空船上与新一代异形相遇，血缘与敌意交织。
导演兼编舞者自述，描绘一位沉迷情欲与毒品的舞者的人生。
films.descriptionEn: Director-choreographer Bob Fosse frames an autobiographical tale through the sordid life of Joe Gideon, a womanizing, drug-using dancer whose career and personal excesses collide.

films.descriptionZh: 一部扑克脸式的伪纪录片，跟随技艺有限的年轻人辗转于电话推销、洗碗、工厂等低薪工作。
films.descriptionEn: A deadpan microbudget mockumentary that follows Randy Scott as he drifts through a series of menial minimum-wage jobs—telemarketer, dishwasher, factory hand, motel attendant—offering a bleakly comic portrait of American working life.

films.descriptionZh: 阿尔萨独自居住在海边破屋，三名年轻人到来打破寂静。
films.descriptionEn: Arsa, about eighteen, lives alone in a rundown hovel overlooking the sea on the edge of an island; when three youngsters arrive and rent a holiday home, their presence begins to change her isolated life.

films.descriptionZh: 爱尔兰青年巴里改名改命，沉浮于18世纪欧洲的军旅、间谍與赌局之间，最终难以赢得真正的接纳。
films.descriptionEn: Redmond Barry leaves Ireland after a fatal duel and pursues fortune across 18th-century Europe as a soldier, spy, and gambler; he marries into aristocracy for wealth but ultimately finds the acceptance he seeks eludes him.

films.descriptionZh: 奥菲斯传说在里约贫民区以森巴与狂欢重述。
films.descriptionEn: The Orpheus and Eurydice legend is transposed to the favelas of Rio, propelled by bossa nova rhythms and carnival fever as a lovesick hero pursues his ill‑fated beloved into the underworld amid exploding local color and dance.

films.descriptionZh: 1970年代，少年因天賦成為成人影壇明星，夢想與現實交鋒。
films.descriptionEn: Set in 1977, a teenager discovers a talent that propels him to celebrity as an adult entertainer while a family of filmmakers tries to redefine the adult industry amid disco, drugs, and shifting fashions.

films.descriptionZh: 日常将人碾为尘土，梦境成了逃生与疯狂的庇护所。
一群青少年闯入商场，却遭遇血腥的高科技杀手机器人。
films.descriptionEn: A group of teens sneaks into a shopping mall only to find themselves hunted by a squad of deadly, high-tech robo-killers, resulting in a relentless B-movie thrill ride full of lasers and exploding robots.

films.descriptionZh: 教授在古老档案中追踪疑似被梵蒂冈掩盖的时间观看装置，走入文字与阴谋的迷宫。
珀尔修斯与众神怪物交锋，奇幻與英雄史詩並行。
一次严重车祸将导演引入以车祸为性刺激的地下亚文化，揭示死亡与欲望的纠缠。
films.descriptionEn: After a severe car crash, a TV director discovers an underground subculture of scarred, omnisexual crash victims who eroticize auto collisions, exploring how danger, death, and sexual obsession intertwine.

films.descriptionZh: 一次车祸将几人带入以血与碎玻璃为欲望对象的恋物与死亡地下世界。
films.descriptionEn: After a collision, a disaffected producer and an enigmatic doctor are drawn, along with the producer’s wife, into a kinky, death-obsessed underworld of car-crash fetishists for whom twisted metal and scar tissue become erotic triggers.

films.descriptionZh: 一位母亲在女儿死后成为胚胎的监护人，跨代情感与身份纠葛缓缓展开。
一个迷恋流行歌手的少女在遭到轻视后走向极端，成为令人不安的心理慢燃惊悚。
films.descriptionEn: Teen runaway Simone’s obsessive love for pop singer “R” turns dark when their real‑life meeting exposes her idol’s callousness, setting off a slow‑burn psychological thriller of parasocial obsession that culminates in a chilling final act.

films.descriptionZh: 曼哈顿一宗血腥谋杀牵出精神科医生、少年与目击妓女的追凶拼图。
films.descriptionEn: After a grisly murder in Manhattan, a psychiatrist, his brilliant teenage son, and a prostitute who witnessed the crime try to piece together what happened while a remorseless killer remains at large.

films.descriptionZh: 影片以辛辣嘲讽描绘封锁时代下的网上狂热与社会走向疯狂。
films.descriptionEn: Astringent and satirical, the film sends up the lockdown era and offers a sharp fictional depiction of a terminally online America, tracing spirals of derangement through a landscape of political and cultural extremes.

films.descriptionZh: 在匈牙利广袤的草原上，古希腊神话被极简长镜头重述，成为对暴政与反抗的冥想。
films.descriptionEn: A hypnotic retelling of the Electra myth set on Hungary’s vast puszta, composed of a handful of intricately staged long takes that transform the ancient tale into a timeless meditation on tyranny and rebellion.

films.descriptionZh: 一名自信商人謀殺情人丈夫，引發一連串不幸事件。
films.descriptionEn: A self‑assured businessman murders his employer—the husband of his mistress—which unintentionally sets off an ill‑fated chain of events.

films.descriptionZh: 路易斯安那一户富裕家庭的女儿目睹父亲不忠，童年纯真随之消逝。
胖小女孩目睹姐姐的初恋与纯真被侵蚀，牵动成长與性觉醒。
讲述莫文·卡拉将死去男友的作品据为己有，随即离开灰色苏格兰前往西班牙。
films.descriptionEn: A sensory, intimate odyssey centering on Morvern Callar, who passes off her deceased boyfriend’s work as her own and escapes gray Scotland for sunlit Spain with her friend, unfolding an enigmatic story of love, death, and theft.

films.canonicalTitle: Four Adventures of Reinette and Mirabelle
films.displayTitle: Four Adventures of Reinette and Mirabelle
films.descriptionZh: 侯麦四段小故事，乡村女孩与巴黎女孩争论生活和道德。

films.canonicalTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.displayTitle: Ghost in the Shell: 30th Anniversary Remaster
films.descriptionZh: 2029年，半机械化的少校追踪一个在信息海洋中诞生的神秘存在。
films.descriptionEn: In 2029 a cyborg Major tracks an omnipotent entity born in a sea of information—an ambiguous hacker or virus threatening world order—while the animation blends hand-drawn and CGI techniques to render her physical and existential journey.

films.descriptionZh: 台北老戏院最后一场放映，各色观众与记忆交织。
王家卫以布宜诺斯艾利斯为背景拍一段反复破裂的爱情。
films.descriptionEn: Two lovers, expatriates in Buenos Aires, navigate the waning days of their relationship against lusty tango bars, bustling sidewalks, and a hypnotic visit to Iguazu Falls, a vivid, stylistic study of love on the brink of dissolution.

films.descriptionZh: 讽刺又辛辣的校园黑色喜剧，毒舌与暗黑笑料交织。
films.descriptionEn: A cynical, surreal dark high‑school comedy that masks sharper themes beneath gleefully nasty putdowns and iconic performances; its bitter humor and memorable lines have made it one of the most influential teen films in modern times.

films.descriptionZh: 年轻女子受欲望与家族诅咒困扰，试图借邻居逃离束缚。
films.descriptionEn: Nawojka, a young woman tormented by monstrous desire and convinced she suffers a hereditary curse, seeks escape from her family’s shackles through Sandra, a sultry neighbor who has returned to the village.

films.descriptionZh: 壮实的英雄深入冥界，寻找圣石以救回被病痛压倒的爱人，途中遭遇僵尸群与邪恶势力。
失业中年人在伦敦雇凶自尽，却因重燃爱情而试图取消契约。
films.descriptionEn: Freshly unemployed and fearful of suicide, a fifty‑year‑old Frenchman in London hires a hitman to end his life, then falls madly in love and scrambles to cancel the contract in this deadpan, disarmingly poignant comedy.

films.descriptionZh: 阿伽門農與王后被命令為遠征特洛伊犧牲女兒，古典悲劇在實景中呈現。
深夜取餐的朋友被困於無盡公路，面對不可名狀的恐怖。
films.descriptionEn: Friends on a late-night food run become trapped on an endless highway where otherworldly terrors lurk outside their Jeep Cherokee, forcing them to choose between accepting fate or attempting escape.

films.descriptionZh: 一位单身母亲在父权社会中坚持独立，经商自足，却要应对子女催她再婚与不堪的追求者。
films.descriptionEn: A funny, endearing study of Faat Kiné, a single mother and successful small‑business owner in Senegal who cherishes her independence but must contend with her grown children’s insistence that she remarry and a parade of unworthy suitors.

films.descriptionZh: 一名大一生在看似平静的海滨小镇发现惊人阴谋，夹杂荒诞对话与血腥笑料。

films.canonicalTitle: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
films.displayTitle: Knife: The Attempted Murder of Salman Rushdie
films.descriptionZh: 围绕对作家萨尔曼·鲁西迪的刺杀未遂及其背景展开。
films.descriptionEn: More than thirty years after Ayatollah Khomeini called for Salman Rushdie’s death over The Satanic Verses, the film examines the attempted murder and its aftermath, beginning with Rushdie’s speaking engagement in Chautauqua, NY.

films.descriptionZh: 巴黎郊区三位青年在骚乱后的一天，怒火不断逼近爆点。
安东尼奥尼凝视一段婚姻在米兰上流社交中悄然瓦解。
勞倫斯在沙漠中聯合阿拉伯部落，掀起對奧斯曼帝國的戰爭與身世探索。
films.descriptionEn: A sweeping biography traces an enigmatic desert-loving Englishman who unites Arab tribes to fight the Ottoman Turks during World War I, presenting a complex portrait of his character and deeds.

films.descriptionZh: 荒原中，孤獨的瑪克斯與一群倖存者駕駛戰車逃離暴君追捕。
films.descriptionEn: Haunted by his past, a lone wanderer becomes swept up with survivors fleeing across the Wasteland in a war rig driven by Furiosa as they escape a tyrannical Citadel and face a relentless pursuit.

films.descriptionZh: 一場夜店謀殺牽出偵探、記者、超時空生物與以超級電腦為首的新興教派。
帕索里尼以梅黛亚为象征，讲述被抛弃的女巫因骗局而走向复仇的悲剧。
一位作家憎恶社会伪装，却发现坦率并非易事。
films.descriptionEn: Alice, a brilliant novelist who despises the carefully constructed lies of modern society, confronts the complexities of truth in a razor-sharp reimagining of Molière’s dark comedy.

films.descriptionZh: 片中如手记般思绪流动，准备在非洲拍摄改编古希腊悲剧。
从神话出发，讲述无知的命运将一人推入与母亲的悲剧纠葛。
films.descriptionEn: A reworking of Sophocles’ tragedy that begins with a prologue in prewar Italy and follows Oedipus as an unwitting victim of his own ignorance, staged with color, stylized costumes, and an almost science-fiction vision of the ancient world.

films.canonicalTitle: Paint Me a Road Out of Here + Q&A | Presented by Miss Video 4 U
films.displayTitle: Paint Me a Road Out of Here + Q&A | Presented by Miss Video 4 U
films.descriptionZh: 一幅画与两代艺术家，五十年间抗争越狱婦女與体制的故事。
一名工程師被前警察兄長牽入危險計劃，家庭命運受威脅。
films.descriptionEn: Set in 1986 Queens and Brooklyn, an engineer aspiring to middle-class stability is pulled into a shady scheme by his former-cop brother, endangering his family and forcing him to confront forces beyond his control.

films.descriptionZh: 梦境记录技术外泄，潜意识影像与现实交织威胁城市秩序。
films.descriptionEn: In a near future where therapists can record dreams with the DC Mini, the theft of a prototype causes subconscious images to bleed into reality, sparking a race to prevent a psychedelic dream apocalypse on the streets.

films.descriptionZh: 影片倒叙重现永浩二十年人生，映射韩国近代创伤史。
films.descriptionEn: Rewinding through twenty years of Yongho’s life, the film moves backward from a tragic present to earlier moments, tracing his loss of humanity against the backdrop of South Korea’s traumatic late-20th-century history.

films.descriptionZh: 胡洛先生在现代化的巴黎迷失于玻璃方盒與奇巧装置构成的都市风景。

films.canonicalTitle: Pretty in Pink x Straight White Men Can't Dance
films.displayTitle: Pretty in Pink x Straight White Men Can't Dance

films.descriptionZh: 太极师傅搬到纽约，与美式化家庭的代际文化冲突以温柔幽默展现。
台北街头的都市孤独与欲望纠缠，少年在游戏厅与小混混间展开复仇与压抑的情感。
在钢琴前的告别独奏，贯穿黄魔乐队到影像配乐的二十首生涯曲目。
纪录片跟随坂本龍一在确诊癌症后重返创作，将对死亡意识化为音乐。
films.descriptionEn: An intimate portrait that follows Ryuichi Sakamoto as he returns to composing after a cancer diagnosis, channeling a renewed awareness of mortality into his latest musical work.

films.descriptionZh: 镜头记录作曲家确诊后三年半的生活、病疗与创作，亲近而温柔。
车库摇滚乐队的贝斯手遇上滑板女孩，却要面对她的一群前任追逐者。
films.descriptionEn: As the bass player in a garage‑rock band, Scott Pilgrim falls for Ramona Flowers, only to discover she carries an army of vengeful ex‑boyfriends who challenge him in increasingly literal, comic‑book‑style battles.

films.descriptionZh: 两位侦探在一座潮湿破败的城市追踪手法极端的连环杀手。
films.descriptionEn: A nearing-retirement detective and his newcomer partner track a serial killer with theatrical methods through a perpetually sodden, decaying city, confronting gruesome crimes and moral collapse.

films.descriptionZh: 巴黎，丧女父亲与神秘精神科医展开追凶复仇之路，正义与执念模糊。
films.descriptionEn: A grieving father and a mysterious psychiatrist embark on a ruthless quest for vengeance after his daughter is murdered, abducting and interrogating suspects across Paris as the line between justice and obsession begins to blur.

films.descriptionZh: 一位导演在片场反复调度，力求拍出真实的模拟性爱场面，同时面对演员脆弱情绪与创作伦理的冲突。
以戰火為背景的絢麗諧趣愛情歌舞，兩人在炸彈轟炸下約定十年重逢，命運巧合又荒誕。
分手后三月，摄影师在洛杉矶漂流，直到一段意外关系迫使他审视爱情與艺术。
小偷赴南美叢林與同夥運送硝化甘油，與大自然展開生死角力。
films.descriptionEn: A small‑time crook from Brooklyn joins fellow hard‑luck men in the sweltering South American jungle to haul nitroglycerine, turning a perilous job into a bleak, elemental confrontation between humans and nature.

films.descriptionZh: 賽車手Speed為保家業揭發賽事被財團操控，與家人並肩挑戰陰謀。
films.descriptionEn: A fearless young racer in the Mach 5 uncovers a conspiracy that fixed major races; to save his family’s legacy and the sport he loves, he must beat the corrupt moguls at their own game.

films.descriptionZh: 十九岁的露西前往托斯卡纳别墅，追寻母亲踪迹与初吻的回忆，同时面对众多追求者。
六位好友在路易斯安那小镇中分享笑泪，面对爱情與失落。
films.descriptionEn: Six close friends in a small Louisiana parish share life’s joys and sorrows—bonding over love, laughter, and grief as they navigate the trials of family and friendship.

films.descriptionZh: 改编自小说，描写少年因母再嫁与父逝世而生恨，刻画现代化下的女性与孝道张力。
年迈的无声影后与年轻编剧在腐朽豪宅中纠缠，命运走向悲剧。
films.descriptionEn: An aging silent-film star holds a struggling young screenwriter in thrall, their doomed relationship unfolding amid a decayed Hollywood mansion and revealing the dark, desperate side of show business.

films.canonicalTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.displayTitle: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
films.descriptionZh: 一位年轻导演前往拜访退隐的原片女星，兩人陷入充滿慾望與恐懼的血腥世界，面對重生與自我實現的試煉。
films.descriptionEn: A young director aiming to revive a camp slasher franchise visits the original film’s reclusive star; their encounter pulls both women into a surreal, bloody world of desire, fear, and delirium under threat from the menacing Little Death.

films.descriptionZh: 一个为上司当情人住所的纽约小职员，在孤独与苦乐之间搅拌出酸涩喜剧。
films.descriptionEn: An anxious insurance employee lets his boss use his small Manhattan apartment as a rendezvous spot while he courts an elevator operator, a bittersweet comedy-drama set against boozy office parties and caustic holiday cheer.

films.canonicalTitle: The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
films.displayTitle: The Best Little Whorehouse in Texas
films.descriptionZh: 当地方名声受威胁，庄园女主人和警长携手保卫并找到爱情。
films.descriptionEn: When a television crusader threatens to expose the local brothel, its proprietress teams up with the sheriff to fight to keep it open—along the way they join forces and find unexpected romance.

films.descriptionZh: 锻刀匠为父亲的死展开复仇之旅，动作影像充满狂热与暴力美学。

films.canonicalTitle: The Bridge on the River Kwai
films.displayTitle: The Bridge on the River Kwai
films.descriptionZh: 一名英军上校在战俘中执著建桥，引发对职责与痴迷的冲突。
films.descriptionEn: A principled British colonel becomes obsessed with leading POWs to build a bridge for their captors in wartime Burma, setting up a tense clash between duty, pride, and obsession.

films.descriptionZh: 一名卧底与警局内的内应互相试图揭露对方。
films.descriptionEn: An undercover cop and a mole within the police force each attempt to identify the other while both infiltrate an Irish gang operating in South Boston.

films.descriptionZh: 一名怯弱上班族發現有個與自己互換身份的雙胞格外同事，生活急轉直下。
偏远苏格兰岛上，兄妹捕猎海鸟并讲述祖辈故事。
films.descriptionEn: On a remote Scottish isle, siblings Isla and Sandy spend their days hunting seabirds and retelling the stories of their ancestors, living a rugged, insular life shaped by family lore.

films.descriptionZh: 蔚蓝科西嘉岛上，少女莱西亚被带到父亲藏身的偏僻别墅。
films.descriptionEn: On a pale, sun‑soaked island of Corsica, teenage Lesia is taken from her sheltered life to a remote villa where her fugitive mob‑boss father is hiding, leaving her to confront a menacing and near‑strange figure who upends her world.

films.descriptionZh: 以轻快笔触改写安徒生，揭示小美人鱼的孤独與渴望。
films.descriptionEn: A sprightly take on Hans Christian Andersen’s tale, the film balances a hot crustacean band and a keening sense of angst and longing embodied in Ariel’s dream of being “Part of Your World,” supported by Menken and Ashman’s celebrated songs.

films.descriptionZh: 退伍兵弗雷迪在二战后误入兰卡斯特·多德创立的新“宗教”船上，寻找归属与纷乱的人际牵绊。

films.canonicalTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.displayTitle: The Night is Short, Walk on Girl
films.descriptionZh: 夜晚的京都奇遇记，少女在纵情狂欢中与形形色色人物相遇，展开荒诞一夜。
一位古籍鑑定者為一本罕見古書遠赴歐洲，卻捲入邪教與神秘事件。
修道院出身的家庭教師贏得馮特拉普家的心，帶領他們逃往自由。
films.descriptionEn: A convent-trained governess wins the hearts of the Von Trapp family and, through courage and music, leads them across the Alps in their 1938 flight to freedom.

films.descriptionZh: 一名工程師失蹤後，後核烏lysses展開尋找新能量物質的荒誕航程。
印象派叙事下的中西部家庭，少年杰克在父子关系与信仰间探索人生。
films.descriptionEn: An impressionistic portrait of a Midwestern family in the 1950s, following eldest son Jack from childhood innocence to disillusioned adulthood as he struggles to reconcile a fraught relationship with his father and the search for meaning.

films.descriptionZh: 一只孤单的长臂猿在马来西亚城市中的消失森林里呼唤，团队争分夺秒赶去营救。
films.descriptionEn: A lone lar gibbon named Han calls from an isolated patch of forest wedged inside a Malaysian metropolis; cut off between highways, his plight spurs a team to race against time to reach him.

films.descriptionZh: 纽约帮派被诬陷后横穿全城返乡的夜行冒险。
一位台湾裔男子为讨父母欢心安排假婚礼，却被父母坚持办起盛大婚宴，文化冲突与情感纠葛交织。

films.canonicalTitle: This Long Century Presents: Salomé Lamas
films.displayTitle: This Long Century Presents: Salomé Lamas
films.descriptionZh: 一位葡萄牙影像艺术家的作品在影像與裝置間游移，探討殖民創傷與集體記憶。
一位准父亲为糊口加入保镖行列，却卷入跨国犯罪與刺杀阴谋，动作爆裂。
一週匆忙拍攝中，樂手在東京的工作與日常被拼貼成影像拼圖。
年仅十九岁的安东尼·布尔丹在普罗温斯敦闯入餐厅厨房，度过塑造他人生的重要夏天。
films.descriptionEn: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, igniting a transformative summer that shapes the course of his life.

films.descriptionZh: 帕里斯劫走海伦，引发万舰奔袭与英雄对决。
一對新戀人帶著走私毒品落跑，暴力與浪漫在逃亡旅程中互相交織。
films.descriptionEn: Clarence Worley, a comic-shop clerk and Elvis aficionado, goes on the run after a whirlwind romance with Alabama and a violent clash that leaves him holding a cache of contraband cocaine, propelling him into a bloody, pulp‑poetic odyssey.

films.canonicalTitle: Wings of Desire + Hidden in Pieces
films.displayTitle: Wings of Desire + Hidden in Pieces
films.descriptionZh: 天使在柏林俯瞰众生，为爱甘愿放弃不朽，人间与梦幻交织。
films.descriptionEn: An angel perched over Berlin hears the thoughts of the city’s inhabitants; when he falls in love with a trapeze artist, he contemplates giving up immortality, creating a poetic city symphony of longing and choice.

films.canonicalTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.displayTitle: Women on the Verge of a Nervous Breakdown
films.descriptionZh: 女配音員佩帕被情人拋棄，引發一連串誇張失控的情感與喜劇事件。
films.descriptionEn: Voice actress Pepa, abandoned by her lover, resolves to kill herself with gazpacho laced with sleeping pills—an act that kicks off a gaudy, cheeky screwball melodrama of unhinged behavior, emotional excess, and tangled relationships.
